insertValueMap.avr_gcc:
.global {{functionName}}

    push r29

    clr r24
    pop r29
    pop r28
    ret

functions.name: Cortex-M vector table and Reset_Handler
functions.insertText:
.syntax unified
.thumb

.section .isr_vector,"a",%progbits
.word {{initialStack}}
.word Reset_Handler
.word NMI_Handler
.word HardFault_Handler

.text
.global Reset_Handler
.type Reset_Handler, %function
Reset_Handler:
    ldr r0, =_sdata
    ldr r1, =_edata
    ldr r2, =_sidata
1:
    cmp r0, r1
    bcc 2f
    b 3f
2:
    ldr r3, [r2], #4
    str r3, [r0], #4
    b 1b
3:
    ldr r0, =_sbss
    ldr r1, =_ebss
4:
    cmp r0, r1
    bcc 5f
    bl SystemInit
    bl main
    b .
5:
    movs r2, #0
    str r2, [r0], #4
    b 4b
functions.description: Cortex-M startup skeleton with vector table, .data copy and .bss clear.
functions.longDescription: Cortex-M startup skeleton with vector table, .data copy and .bss clear.

functions.name: ATmega328P Arduino UNO LED blink assembly
functions.insertText:
.include "avr/io.h"
.text
.global main
main:
    sbi DDRB, DDB5
loop:
    sbi PORTB, PORTB5
    rcall delay
    cbi PORTB, PORTB5
    rcall delay
    rjmp loop

delay:
    ldi r18, {{outerCount}}
1:  ldi r19, {{innerCount}}
2:  dec r19
    brne 2b
    dec r18
    brne 1b
    ret
functions.description: Arduino UNO PB5 LED blink in AVR assembly.
functions.longDescription: Arduino UNO PB5 LED blink in AVR assembly.
